mapper.sql: select host_id, folder_id, host_name, protocol, address, port, username, auth_method, password_enc, private_key_enc, passphrase_enc, allow_reveal, role_keys, note, sort, status, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from itm_team_host
mapper.select: where status = '0' order by sort, host_name
select count(*) from itm_team_host where folder_id = #{folderId}
mapper.insert: insert into itm_team_host (folder_id, host_name, protocol, address, port, username, auth_method, allow_reveal, role_keys, note, sort, status, version, create_by, create_time) values (ifnull(#{folderId}, 0), #{hostName}, ifnull(#{protocol}, 'SSH'), #{address}, ifnull(#{port}, 22), ifnull(#{username}, ''), ifnull(#{authMethod}, 'PASSWORD'), ifnull(#{allowReveal}, '0'), ifnull(#{roleKeys}, ''), ifnull(#{note}, ''), ifnull(#{sort}, 0), ifnull(#{status}, '0'), 1, ifnull(#{createBy}, ''), sysdate())
mapper.delete: delete from itm_team_host where host_id in #{id}
